flags.estimate: Leave the datamined chargeFrames 60 / reloadFrames 141 / ammo 6 as-is, but expect her REAL per-shot cycle to be ~1s LONGER than the sim's (the kit's own 'Full Charge maintained for 1 or more seconds' gate implies she holds full charge ~1s before releasing, which an instant-release charge model does not have). First estimate: effective cycle ≈ charge 1.0s + hold ~1.0s + release, i.e. ~6 pulls per 12-13s + 2.35s reload, vs ~6 pulls per 6-7s + reload unmodeled.
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #1: rate_of_fire/reloadFrames are known-unreliable datamine fields, and here a second, kit-internal signal contradicts the instant-release assumption. This is load-bearing in BOTH directions: every one of her three per-pull effects (the 220.7% rider, the team heal, the shield/Goddess Blessing duty cycle) scales directly with pull count, so a cycle that is 2x too fast roughly doubles her modeled skill damage and heal cadence.
flags.recipe: Frame-count a focus recording of rapunzel-sanctuary firing a full magazine out of Full Burst: measure (a) charge-start → muzzle-flash, (b) flash → next charge-start, (c) dry → first shot of the next magazine. Cross-check against the arithmetic total (shots x 220.7% rider popups per 10s window) and against the Goddess Blessing re-apply interval — the three must agree.

flags.estimate: fullCharge as the proxy trigger; one activation per charged pull, with the DEF side throttled to one per 10s by noRetriggerWhileActive.
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #2-adjacent: 'Full Charge is maintained for 1 or more seconds' is not an engine trigger. fullCharge is the nearest kit-shaped primitive (a charged release, which in-sim happens only at full charge). The real line can also fire WITHOUT a shot (holding charge and releasing aim), which the proxy cannot express — if she is played hold-and-release, the real activation rate can exceed the shot rate.
flags.recipe: Record a hold-without-firing sequence: does the Goddess Blessing DEF icon / shield appear while she holds charge and never fires? If yes, the correct primitive is a time-in-charge trigger (none exists) and the proxy under-counts; pin the observed re-apply period and encode it as an interval block instead.

flags.field: skill2[0] (shield block) — missing negated Goddess Blessing gate
flags.estimate: Shield re-emits on every full charge (≈6 per magazine) where the kit emits it ≈once per 10s. Over-emission factor ⚑ ≈ 4-6x on ally `shielded` triggers; zero effect on her own damage.
flags.reasoning: `shield` has no noRetriggerWhileActive and there is no requiresNotSelfStatus gate, so only the DEF buff could be throttled. I deliberately did NOT fudge an everyN to hide this (an everyN would also drift as her cadence changes) — the cadence error is visible and flagged instead of silently baked in.
flags.recipe: Run her with a shield-synergy consumer (a `shielded`-trigger or requiresShielded kit) and compare that consumer's proc count against footage of the same pair; if the sim over-procs, add everyN to the shield block set to the MEASURED charges-per-Goddess-Blessing-cycle, or extend the schema with a negated self-status gate.

flags.reasoning: The shield exists only while she holds full charge; the kit's own gate says that hold is '1 or more seconds'. 1s is the stated floor, not a measurement. A long duration here would be the classic duration-semantics error (it would leave allies permanently shielded and flip every requiresShielded gate permanently on).
flags.recipe: Same focus recording as the cadence flag: time the shield bar's appearance → disappearance across several charges and take the median hold.

flags.field: skill1[1].target / skill2[2].target ('Into the Fray' cross-unit status)
flags.estimate: alliesInStatus{statusPrefix:'Into the Fray', includeSelf:true} — in an isolation/control comp this resolves to SELF ONLY, so her modeled team contribution from these two lines is ~1/5 of her real one on a comp that supplies the status.
flags.reasoning: This kit never grants 'Into the Fray'; it is granted elsewhere on the roster, so the status-prefix match (exact name, and which units open it) is outside this blind input domain. Keying these blocks to plain `allies` instead would OVER-CREDIT every comp that lacks the status provider — the over-credit direction is worse than the under-credit, so the gated form is the correct default.
flags.recipe: Grep the tree for `selfStatus` effects whose `name` starts with 'Into the Fray' to confirm the exact prefix and the granting unit(s); then grade her once in a comp containing a granter and once without, and confirm the buffApply targetSlug set widens from {self} to the full squad.

flags.reasoning: The kit says '42.24% of the SKILL USER'S DEF', which is a caster-scaled grant; the StatKey enum has casterAtkPct / atkOfCasterMaxHpPct / casterMaxHpPct but no caster-scaled DEF. Encoding it as defPct preserves the magnitude and the audit trail while mis-stating the basis (target's own DEF). Zero damage consequence today — defPct is documented inert — so this is a completeness record, not a number to trust.
flags.recipe: No in-sim check is possible while defPct is inert. When a DEF consumer lands (a DEF-scaling ATK conversion or boss damage), add a casterDefPct StatKey and re-author; until then assert only that the buffApply fires on all allies with the 10s duty cycle.

flags.reasoning: The kit calls the immunity continuous but scopes the activation clause to 'only when at Full Charge during a Full Charge attack'; statImmunities is whole-fight and cannot express the narrower scope. Because she is a charge weapon that is essentially always charging, whole-fight is the right approximation — and it is DAMAGE-RELEVANT in the conservative direction (she refuses ally charge-speed buffs, lowering her shot count vs an un-immune model).
flags.recipe: Grade her in a comp with a chargeSpeedPct granter (e.g. an Alice/Liter-style charge-speed buffer) and confirm no chargeSpeedPct buffApply survives on her, and that her shot count is unchanged vs the same comp without the granter.

flags.estimate: One recovery event per full charge, to all allies including self.
flags.reasoning: Kit-literal per-pull cadence, but its only live consequence is driving ally on-`recovery` consumers, whose proc count therefore inherits the full cadence ⚑ above. 'Affects all allies' is read as including self per the NIKKE convention.
flags.recipe: Pair her with an on-recovery consumer and compare its proc count per 10s window against footage; if the sim over-procs by a constant factor, the error is the cadence tuple, not the heal.

flags.estimate: Burst collapses to exactly one effect: allies casterAtkPct 34.84 / 10s on every own-burst cast. The revive branch, the +40s burst-cooldown penalty, the continuous DEF ▲10%, and the 101.37%/221.76% once-per-battle grants all contribute ZERO at v1 scope.
flags.reasoning: v1 has an immortal boss and no HP pool, so no ally is ever incapacitated; 'Nanoparticle Injection' can never fire, so 'Nanoparticle Consumption' can never be entered. Both reachable readings of her burst grant the SAME 34.84% line, which is what makes the collapse safe rather than a guess. The real-fight behaviour (a revive comp where she eats a +40s cooldown) is a different unit entirely and must not be inferred from this model.
flags.recipe: Assert the collapse directly: count buffApply events with stat 'casterAtkPct' and the flat value (34.84/100 x caster staticAtk) — expect exactly one per burstCast per ally, and ZERO buffApply for the 101.37/221.76 magnitudes. If an HP/incapacitation model ever lands, re-author the burst as two branches plus the skill1 NC chain and re-grade; her burst cadence will change (40s cd + 40s penalty) and that is the dominant effect, not the buff magnitudes.

flags.estimate: NOT set — the 220.7% rider takes the +50% Full Burst major by landing timing (default ON).
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #6: noFb is measured-only and defaults OFF. Her rider is a per-pull function-damage hit, not burst-cast/instant damage, so the FB-exemption precedent does not apply. If it is in fact exempt, her modeled skill bucket is over-credited by up to 1.5x inside FB windows.
flags.recipe: Compare two 220.7% popups from the same focus recording — one inside Full Burst, one outside — at the same buff state; a ratio of 1.0 means noFb:true, ~1.5 means the default is right.

flags.estimate: N/A — not flagged, this kit has NO Hit Rate line.
flags.reasoning: Recorded explicitly so the judge can distinguish 'absent from the kit' from 'dropped by the parser'. Her only core-relevant datum is the base coreAttackMultiplier 200 on normal attacks; the 220.7% rider is authored core-ineligible (no 'core strike damage' wording).
flags.recipe: None required. If a future reading shows the rider coring, that is a schema/authoring change (core:true), not a hitRatePct derivation.
